name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate

entry.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate
entry.note: The AWS machine learning credential still on offer after the Machine Learning Specialty was retired in March 2026
entry.audience: ML engineers and MLOps practitioners building on AWS

covers: Generative AI implementation with Amazon Bedrock and RAG architectures
Foundation model and LLM selection, fine-tuning, and operationalization
reading.format: Delivered at Pearson VUE testing centers or via online proctored exam. Questions are multiple choice and multiple response.
reading.status: The current exam version (MLA-C01) in English is available through September 28, 2026. Registration for the updated version (MLA-C02) opens September 1, 2026. MLA-C01 in Korean, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese remains available until general availability of MLA-C02.
reading.summary: This certification validates technical ability to implement machine learning workloads in production and operationalize them. It is intended to show readiness for machine learning engineering roles. The updated exam includes generative AI, agentic AI, foundation models, and responsible AI topics.
reading.audience: The page lists individuals with at least one year of experience using Amazon SageMaker AI, Amazon Bedrock, and other ML engineering AWS services. Target roles include ML engineer, MLOps engineer, LLMOps engineer, data engineer, backend software developer, and data scientist.
reading.prerequisites: The page states at least one year of experience using Amazon SageMaker AI, Amazon Bedrock, and other ML engineering AWS services for the updated exam, or Amazon SageMaker and other ML engineering AWS services for the current exam.
